about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Who I am
about.text1: Full-stack web and mobile developer, recently graduated in Computer Science (Software Engineering) from Université Adventiste Zurcher. I build modern web and mobile applications with React, Next.js, Node.js and TypeScript.
about.text2: My final-year project, AllMada, is a Malagasy e-commerce marketplace made of a web app, a mobile app and a shared backend. I worked on REST APIs, JWT authentication, multi-role management (admin, sellers, customers), shops, products, orders and payments, as well as MongoDB, Docker and Git/GitHub.
about.text3: What I bring to you: clean and readable code, clear communication, on-time delivery, and real attention to detail so your project works from day one.
about.p1desc: Readable, tested, object-oriented code that's ready to grow with your project.
about.p2desc: From design to going live: mockups, development, testing, deployment.
about.p3desc: Your satisfaction and your project's success are my priorities.
about.infoEducationValue: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Université Adventiste Zurcher, 2023 – 2026
about.infoAvailabilityValue: Available for missions, internships and freelance projects

allmada.title: AllMada — E-commerce Marketplace
allmada.description: Final-year project: design and development of a Malagasy web and mobile marketplace with an architecture close to professional e-commerce platforms. Dual administration: a platform administrator supervises the marketplace, while each seller has their own shop to manage products, orders and activities.

plume-relais.title: Plume Relais — Collaborative Writing
plume-relais.description: Mobile collaborative writing app where each participant blindly adds a paragraph to an ongoing story. At each round, multiple continuations are proposed and the community votes for the official one. A blend of exquisite corpse and writing social network, in real time.

speaker.title: Speaker Recognition
speaker.description: AI prototype that distinguishes the user's voice from another person's voice using voice embeddings.

ocr.title: OCR Application for Exams
ocr.description: Image processing and grading assistance app with KNN classification, results visualization and document generation.

bible.title: Bible Mobile App
bible.description: Mobile app with navigation, multilingual support and backend services integration.

portfolio.title: Personal Portfolio — Next.js
portfolio.description: Bilingual (FR/EN) portfolio designed and built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4 and Framer Motion. Smooth animations, contact form via Resend, automatic deployment on Vercel. Modern, responsive and SEO-optimized design.

invisible-queue.title: Invisible Queue — Virtual Waiting Lines
invisible-queue.description: Mobile app that digitizes physical waiting lines. Users join a nearby queue, track their real-time position and get notified as their turn approaches. Supabase for authentication and real-time sync, guest or logged-in mode, delay and turn management, mandatory geolocation.

sonicflow.title: SonicFlow — Android Audio Player
sonicflow.description: Local Android audio player built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Background playback via MediaSessionService (Media3), custom playlists managed with Room (many-to-many relations), dynamic filtering and sorting, and interactive waveform visualization generated from MediaExtractor.
